text: 2026年11月6日下午，财政部副部长廖岷在京会见美国泛大西洋投资集团董事长福特，就中美经贸关系、人工智能等进行沟通交流。（财政部网站）
text_en: On the afternoon of November 6, 2026, Vice Minister of Finance Liao Min met in Beijing with Ford, Chairman of General Atlantic, to exchange views on China-US economic and trade relations, artificial intelligence and other topics. (Ministry of Finance website)
